purpose: First semantics-preserving performance revision after actual940 engineering failure
hypothesis: Removing three proved-redundant outer deepcopy calls for default scheduler/checker preserves full plans/state and custom-hook isolation, while reducing actual internal plan runtime. Whether it meets1s remains an empirical check.
allowed_changes: Only default schedule/check outer input copies; provided custom hooks keep old isolation
Prototype label and construction-local directory adaptation
forbidden_changes: Original B sources or prior failures
checker internal copies or rule validation
scores/cash/old labor values or acceptance thresholds

equivalence_requirement: Same exact opened fixture in isolated modules; complete plan and state field-by-field equal, only explicit candidate label metadata may be separated. No partial prefix accepted as whole-plan proof.
performance_requirement: Record both one-shot raw runtimes and1s outcome; extended guard is diagnostic completion only and does not relax gate.
failure_policy: Keep every timeout/mismatch, no retry selecting fastest; further revision needs distinct falsifiable hypothesis and sourcefreeze.
